items.evidence: roll.py --headless --board 3 --inputs "246:right,276:none,381:left,396:none,530:right,550:none": third coin at tick 581 adds clear and the screen stays play on board 4 (texts Board 4 of 4, score 30), ball reset to (-3,1.25,0), coins (-2,0),(2.2,0),(3.5,1.5). --board 4 is accepted; game.py BOARDS[4] has slab (-4,4,-2,2) and the ramp.

--board 4 --inputs 60:right: y 0.65 at x 0.10, 0.85 at x 0.68, then 1.00 at x 1.29 and 0.98 at x 1.63, airborne past the top. My own box-distance check on the brief's ramp geometry gave ball clearance never below 0 (to 4 decimals) for side hits from -z, +z and from the high +x end, and for drops from above at (0,2,0), (0.5,4,0.5) and (-0.5,0.3,0) with vy -6.

Board 4 with right held from the start takes the (2.2,1.2,0) coin at tick ~170 with the ball at x 2.0, y 0.89, which is in flight past the ramp top. Script 70:right,90:none,120:left,140:none,150:down,170:none,215:up,232:none,250:right,280:none,480:left,500:none,520:left,550:none,700:right,730:none,740:up,760:none,808:down,828:none,840:right on --board 4 ends with screen won (score 30, clear last). The same script appended at +581 to the board-3 script gives won, score 60. Later ticks change nothing and enter goes to the title.
--board 1..4 in en/es/fr: Board n of 4, Tablero n de 4, Plateau n sur 4 on all twelve.

Language menu_right cycles en->es->fr->en, and menu_left goes en->fr. In fr: title Roll/Jouer/Reglages/Quitter, settings Reglages/Volume/Langue: Francais/Balle: Normale/Retour, play Plateau/Score :/Vies :, paused Pause/Reprendre/Retour au titre, won Vous avez gagne !, lost Partie terminee, with Appuyez sur Entree... on both. language is fr. I opened the PNG frames of all six screens and every text was French with accents drawn.

Settings rows Volume, Language, Ball, Back. Ball: Normal at first. menu_left gives Light and stays Light, menu_right gives Normal then Heavy and stays Heavy. Bola: Pesada in es, Balle: Legere/Normale in fr. ball_kind in the state follows each change.

Board 2 with settings dirs set by the menu to light/normal/heavy and script 40:right,100:none: the ball x the tick before the strike is -0.5581 for all three. Summed crate displacement 120 ticks after the strike: light 0.31, normal 1.07, heavy 4.51. With 40:right,70:none it is 0.085/0.209/0.913.

Run 1 set volume 6, fr, light and settings.json was written. Run 2 with the same dir starts at 6, fr, light. A hand-written old file {volume:5, language:es} loads as 5, es, normal. No dir gives 8, en, normal.

Re-ran m01-m22 and m24 through roll.py: all pass (m10 board 1 script reaches board 2 at rest at (-3,1.25,0) with 3 coins, 6 crates, score 40, coin and clear; m08 first contact tick 26, 3 bounces; m12 4 crates moved, arrival 143 vs 127 empty; m15 1,2,1,0; m17 now goes to board 4 then won at board 4; m20 identical JSON; m03 WAVs 0.3/0.2/0.9/0.9 s, non-silent, distinct). m23 failed before and is not held against it.

Frames of board 4 at tick 60 and tick 150 are 800x480 PNGs. Looked at both: the green slab, the brown ramp drawn as a thick slab whose edge rises toward +x, the red shaded ball (on the ramp at tick 150) and the untaken coins (the taken (-2,0) coin is gone).
CHANGES.md lists each change with its files and functions, says what was checked (selftest additions, frames viewed), and lists faults found before the change.

defects: Board 4 frame: the ball's ground shadow is drawn on top of the ramp at floor level (shows through the ramp under the ball).
A push held when a board ends stays held on the next board (a held down push carries into board 2; the builder noted it as pre-existing).
Coins on boards 3 and 4 render as dark brown discs, much darker than the gold coins of board 2.
